name: Swarm of Hollow Peals
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Traits.name: Swarm
Traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.name: Bell
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 32 (6d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage, or 16 (3d10) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

Actions.name: Sorrowing Toll
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 56 (16d6) Necrotic damage. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.expresses: the death-toll that saps the dying and marks them for the swarm

lore: Forged in a churchyard foundry where the dead were rung over, this swarm of bells broke from its ropes one winter and now drifts from battlefield to sickbed, tolling for the dying it can reach.

generation.userConcept: a swarm of funeral bells that ring themselves over the dying
generation.gap_death_sites: 1x the call named no template for the pick

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsterDescription: a swarm of funeral bells that ring themselves over the dying
